clips.title: The story
paras: Along Loch Modan’s southern road, Huldar’s powder run has come to a halt. His wagon carries blast powder for the southern dig, but threats on the road have put the delivery in danger.

Huldar’s wagon is stranded on the road through southern Loch Modan. He was sent with loads of mining blast powder for the excavation site, where dwarven archaeologists and prospectors need supplies. Local wildlife and troggs threaten the route near the lake’s southern bend. Dark Iron infiltrators also lurk there. With his wagon damaged, Huldar depends on passing travelers to guard the remaining powder kegs and carry the shipment to the dig.
